pipelines_scope_paired.name: pipelines_scope_paired
pipelines_scope_paired.value:
(
    (scope = 'global' AND company_id IS NULL AND project_id IS NULL) OR
    (scope = 'company' AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id IS NULL) OR
    (scope = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND company_id IS NULL)
  )

stages_probability_range.name: stages_probability_range
stages_probability_range.value: probability IS NULL OR (probability >= 0 AND probability <= 100)

tasks_dates_paired.name: tasks_dates_paired
tasks_dates_paired.value: (start_date IS NULL AND due_date IS NULL) OR (start_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= due_date)

tasks_progress_range.name: tasks_progress_range
tasks_progress_range.value: progress_pct IS NULL OR (progress_pct >= 0 AND progress_pct <= 100)
